newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar tightly mixed, Dec/March focus.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar tightly mixed, Dec/March focus.

text.p: Activity on London's white sugar futures market was centred around the nearby December/March spread in modest Monday turnover with commission house players dominating the afternoon, market sources said.
While some Dec/March crosses were also reported, one leading commission house bought the spread and the firmness was then balanced by scale-selling on the part of another house.
A lacklustre performance on the New York raws market was not providing much impetus to London either, they added.

"It's bits and pieces, there's nothing major," said one. "New York is very slow but it will take a while to pick up." At 1657 GMT positions were tightly mixed with the nearby contracts at the bottom end of their tight trading ranges.

December was down 30 cents at $317.00 and March down 60 cents at $313.50. Volume reached 1,289 lots. Market open interest is now concentrated in the second-month March position, followed by December and then May. Technically, March's recent firmness is still in line with a downtrend channel dating from a September 17 reaction low at $325.50.
The contract should meet chart resistance at slightly above $315, followed by the 20-day moving average at $317.40.
Momentum indicators for both nearby contracts are clawing their way out of negative territory, approaching the neutral zero barrier.
Paris trading was dull with just 455 lots on the board and price movements similar to those in London.
December was down 60 cents at $316.40 and March down 50 cents at $314.00.
